messages:
maria: quick heads-up — need a short sync on enrichment/affinity for cost attribution. thinking about edge vs late-resolve tradeoffs.
jonah: can we avoid enriching at the edge? my main worry is cardinality + envelope bloat.
kevin: we still need a deterministic billing key. if sampling happens before enrichment we lose attribution.
tara: what if we attach a lightweight billing-hint at the edge and do authoritative resolution in enrichment? best of both worlds.
maria: that sounds promising if the hint is tiny and not PII. e.g., tenant fingerprint + source hint.
jonah: concern: even small hints add up at scale. quick calc: 24 bytes * 1M rps * 86.4k secs/day -> ~2TB/day of extra ingress.
kevin: oof. that's the envelope bloat problem we flagged last quarter. finance will scream.
tara: where did 24 bytes come from? base64 hash? we can use an 8-byte fingerprint (64-bit) instead and namespace it.
maria: 8 bytes + 1 byte namespace + small svc id should be safe. risk = collisions, but we can detect & resolve later.
jonah: another alternative: keep enrichment later and rely on probabilistic scaling for sampled traces, i.e., infer cost attribution for sampled subset and scale.
kevin: probabilistic scaling hurts accuracy; finance wants <1% skew on chargeback.
tara: proposed plan: 1) edge attaches 8B fingerprint + service id (non-PII) 2) enrichment stage resolves fingerprint -> tenant and writes authoritative tenant id 3) storage keeps both fingerprint and resolved tenant for reconcile/backfill
maria: also add a "pending_billing" marker if enrichment fails so we don't silently misbill. route those traces to a late-resolve queue.
jonah: config snippet for edge header idea:
```
# ingest edge headers
X-BILLING-FP: "h=0x7f8a2b3c"
X-SVC: "frontend"
```
kevin: ops notes: need throttle/queue depth controls on late-resolve path; also perf sim for enrichment latency distribution.
tara: I'll draft an RFC addendum with perf numbers and a prototype fingerprint lib to simulate 1M rps. @maria can you loop in finance to confirm 1% tolerance?
maria: will do, drafting addendum in ~24h.
observability-bot: reminder: rfc template exists at /rfc/templates — assigning draft id #4884 to tara.
kevin: one more security point: don't send raw keys. use HMAC/truncated digest with service-specific key in edge.
maria: agreed. HMAC + truncation + namespace. thanks all — next step: tara will drop a prototype and numbers, i'll coordinate finance and security review.
